title: Location login config API, contract v1.1 (slice S2a, screen 9)
description: Request/response bodies for the location login config API. Prose, check order, error table and DDL intent: v1.1-S2a-location-login-config.md. Table columns [SRC: LD §4.1 L167]. secret_ref is WRITE-ONLY: it appears only in write requests, never in any response, event or log [SRC: LD §4.1 L171 'secret_ref is never shown (only set / rotated on)'] [TL Decision, S2a brief]. Labels: [SRC], [Confirmed DEC-n], [TL Decision], ASSUMPTION, OPEN.

id.description: UUID string; same rule as claims/audit schemas (format uuid plus 8-4-4-4-12 pattern, CR-01).

tenant_id.description: Entra tenant id (tid). Lower-case canonical form in responses. The nil UUID is refused (ASSUMPTION A-7).

tenant_ids.description: Column is uuid[] [SRC: LD §4.1 L167]; the API accepts EXACTLY ONE for entra and none for database [TL Decision, S2a interim; LD §4.2 L188 'a location lists one allowed tenant ID'].

oidc_authority.description: Absolute https BASE URL, scheme+host[:port] only, no path, query, fragment or userinfo, no trailing slash, e.g. https://login.microsoftonline.com. The login service builds {authority}/{tid}/v2.0 per request [TL Decision, S2a brief].

secret_ref_input.description: WRITE-ONLY, opaque. ASSUMPTION A-1: shaped like an AWS Secrets Manager ARN [SRC: LD §4.1 L168 'secret_ref is an AWS Secrets Manager ARN']. Fixtures use fake account 000000000000 and the word FAKE. Secret kind (client secret vs certificate) deferred.

display_name.description: 'Name shown on the sign-in page' [SRC: mockup 09]. Trimmed length 1..100 (ASSUMPTION A-9).

reason.description: Written reason. Required (non-null) for a downgrade [Confirmed DEC-096, DEC-098]. Trimmed length 1..500 (ASSUMPTION A-10; minimum length OPEN OQ-S2a-7). Stored in the change row and the event.

slug.description: Server-generated, >=64 bits of randomness [SRC: LD §4.3 L193]. Match rule after trim + ASCII lower-case [TL Decision, S2a brief].

login_config_write.description: Full replacement of the editable fields (PUT body and the login_config of a create). Every editable key is REQUIRED (send null / [] explicitly) so nothing is cleared silently. secret_ref: absent = keep current; string = replace (rotation); null = clear (only when switching to database). row_version is NOT in the body: it travels in If-Match. Unknown keys -> 422 unknown_field.

create_location_request.description: POST create: a location cannot be created without a provider choice [SRC: LD §4.1 L169 'The location-creation screen requires a provider choice']. slug is server-generated (not accepted). On create an entra secret_ref must be a string (no current secret to keep).

secret_view.description: The only secret information ever returned [SRC: LD §4.1 L171]. rotated_at = time of the latest change row whose changed_fields contains secret_ref (ASSUMPTION A-3); null when set is false.

login_config_view.description: GET / PUT 200 / POST 201 body. Closed: no secret_ref key exists (additionalProperties false). row_version mirrors the ETag.

audited_state.description: The before/after shape shared by the change row and auth.provider.changed. Exactly these four keys; never secret_ref [SRC: LD §4.1 L184 'before/after provider kind and tenant ids, no secrets'] [Confirmed DEC-096/098 for the two flags].

changed_field.description: Field NAMES only (never values). secret_ref here means 'replaced or cleared', the value is never recorded (ASSUMPTION A-4).

change_history.description: GET .../login-config/changes body (screen 9 'Change history' [SRC: mockup 09]). Newest first. Reads follow org:V (ASSUMPTION A-11; OPEN OQ-S2a-9 whether reason text is shown to view-only readers).

error_code.description: Top-level error codes; table in the spec §5.

error_response.description: Every non-2xx body except 401 (no body, WWW-Authenticate only, as LD row 148 pattern). Never echoes submitted values (no secret_ref, no tenant ids).

field.description: JSON pointer-ish name, e.g. entra_allowed_tenant_ids/0 or login_config/secret_ref.

current_row_version.description: 409 only: lets the UI show the 'Someone else changed this setting' banner [SRC: mockup 09] and reload.
